title: ggtts-instruments/1
description: Which instruments a ggtts run starts. Every key has a flag, and a flag overrides the file: --instruments FILE, --instrument NAME[,timeout_s=S][,command=PATH][,version=V][,needs_events=B][,interpreter=PROG][,arg.K=V], --require NAME, --on-instrument-error, --instrument-timeout.

device.description: Default requested instrument device; per-instrument args.device overrides it for instruments that support devices.

on_error.description: After an instrument fails or times out: continue (the default) runs the rest; abort marks the rest skipped. The render's output is kept either way.

timeout_s.description: Seconds each instrument may run before it is killed and recorded as timeout. Default 60.

require.description: The instruments the measurement depends on. Any of them missing, failed, timed out, skipped or invalid makes the measurement INCOMPLETE (exit 3), never a pass. Flag: --require NAME.

name.description: A shipped instrument's name, also its report directory.

command.description: An instrument of your own: the program to start. Needs version.

interpreter.description: Run the command (a script) with this program, e.g. python3. Windows cannot start a .py file directly.

needs_events.description: It needs the run's event stream; without one, or with a truncated one (no end event), it is skipped.

args.description: Passed to the instrument as --KEY VALUE.
